G1_hero.h1: Molecision MP — automated nucleic acid extraction systems
G1_hero.lead: Molecision MP is a range of two automated Snibe nucleic acid extractors that differ in the number of samples per run: MP-32 processes up to 32 samples and MP-96 up to 96. According to the manufacturer, both systems complete extraction from 11 minutes and work with plasma, serum, whole blood, swabs and other specimen types.

T10_faq.h2: Questions and answers about Molecision MP

items.q: Which models are included in Molecision MP?
items.a: The range includes Molecision MP-32 and Molecision MP-96 — two automated Snibe nucleic acid extractors that differ in the number of samples per run.

items.q: How many samples does Molecision MP process per run?
items.a: Molecision MP-32 processes 1 to 32 samples per run, and Molecision MP-96 processes 1 to 96.

items.q: Which specimen types does Molecision MP support?
items.a: According to Snibe, both models work with these specimen types: plasma, serum, whole blood, sputum, saliva, swabs, BALF, CSF, urine, stool.

items.q: How long does extraction take on Molecision MP?
items.a: According to the manufacturer, extraction takes from 11 minutes.

items.q: Who supplies and maintains Molecision MP in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is an official Snibe distributor in Ukraine. It helps select the most effective solution for your needs and provides supply, installation, staff training, warranty and post-warranty maintenance, and application support.

T12_contact.text: Tell us how many samples you process per run and which specimen types you use, and we will help you select a system for your laboratory.
